day 5   friday 15th may 
w/l : 2 losses (-340)
bias : overall bias was bullish for the day , was thinking a retracement into discount on htf would be good before continueing higher but wouldnt be surprised if it just pumped . it was my birthday and was busy in the afternoon so i just checked what was going on in london session and i saw a good setup so i decided to take the risk as i wasnt going to be trading later anyway 

trade 1:  price retraced/manipulated into WO , 4hr ob , ote of the htf range . i missed out on the first good entry as i saw it playing out as i hopped on the charts which was a 5min rb , smt entry off of what i just mentioned . i waited to see if price wanted to come back into the range before expanding to tdo which was my target because there was no trading above it , there was a retracement into ote of the range and the 5min gap then price made a 5min rb and there was 2 smt so i limited just above the ce of the rb and 0.795 with a 10pt sl 5micros , tp was just below london high and wouldve been 12rr

trade 2 : this second entry wasnt so good but it seemed like a good setup in the memont i got a bit too married to my bias i think , the smt was holding and there was also now cvd divergence , price came just below 0.795 tapping a 5min rb made off another and a 1min ob , 5min rb was made and i limited a 1min ob within it with a 20pt sl 5micros , trade was 7rr , i did get some slippage though (edited)

day 4   thursday 14th may 
w/l : 1 loss 1 win (+600)
bias : bullish , 1D tf was respecting a fvg and we at ath so longs are in favour , originally i was expecting discount of the htf to be mitigated before distributing back to ath but that didnt happen , there were 2 bullish smt and 9:30 displaced upwards very agressively so if price was going to come back down below the low longs would be off the table 

trade 1:  i wanted to see price retrace back into the range it was in and the 5min gap , this did happen but it was right before 10am opened so i decided to wait but then i was thinking that the manipulation into ote+5min gap was enough for 10am to just distribute because there was nothing lower that interested me anyway . so i wanted to limit 10am KO as it was also the open of the 5min rb made and the rr wouldve been good + it was on 0.795 of the range , i ended up fomoing into a trade before the level was hit because a 1min rb was made off discount of the small range and 1min ob (i lost 200) and then price delivered from 10am KO like i wanted but i didnt take it , there was also cvd divergence whereas there wasnt that or smt on my entry (it was a bad entry but i had the right trade idea) i shouldve been more patient (i also got a horrible fill on this trade because i market entered) and wouldve had to hold passed ath just to get 4rr (30pt sl with 3 micros) 

trade 2 : i waited to see if there was a retracement before ath was taken again if so i wouldve hopped off , there was a bearish smt but it didnt really bother me because i thought there was a very low chance price dumps from here especially because we edged asia high/ath , price retraced to 0.5 which was aligned with 1min rb and ote of 5min gap so i limited the level with 11.5pt sl at the low of the rb targetting a previous high because in the moment i wasnt thinking to target asia high hit tp for (800) there was also an smt at the 1min rb low

-----------------------------------------------------

so this is a recap of the trade i took yesterday because i was out and did not have time to journal. Basically as i mentioned the same shit as the day before.

Again still bullish at ATH until proven wrong also we had almost no trading upwards of TDO. First of all we had like this 4h RB that was rejecting a previous daily gap we were trading inside. 9.30 opened and just chopped - tbh i really did not watch 9.30 at all because i had limited time so i just put an alarm for 09:55 to trade the 10 AM candle. I saw 09:45 we made a nice 5m RB that rejected OTE of the 4h RB. When 10AM opened i saw similar scenario as the day before where we had 12 pts manipulation which is like almost nothing and it was in the 10 AM candle. but it basically receted of the .79 of the leg of the 5m range, rejected the NDOG again and also rejected a very small 1m fvg (its not a really decent one but still technically it is).

10 AM lined up perfectly with the beginning of the 1m Rb and the CE of the 1m FVG and NDOG and almost .709 of OTE which was enough for me to try it again also thinking of the day prior where the same played out. i actually had my SL at 15pts and not the RB so i can cover the .79 because it did not mitigate it yet but retroperspectively my SL was trash because it would have invalidated the rb before so did not make sense. my tp was a static 6rr since im on funded now i dont need to go crazy with the pnl because of consistency rule and everything but this mf went to 23rr.

really decent trade im proud of myslef i was not greedy and targeted a higher RR. I mean my TP does not make sense technically but for account health it was perfect! So only thing i could have done better was my SL placement (edited)
